hazards.hazard: E-1 vent line (small pipe to atmosphere) too small for emergency vapour release during runaway — pressure builds in R-1 beyond PSV-1/manway capacity, vessel rupture.
hazards.reason: E-1 vents to atmosphere through a small pipe; design capacity not documented; no automatic venting or dumping installed; if runaway generates vapour faster than small vent + PSV-1 + manway can handle, pressure rises uncontrollably.

hazards.hazard: No emergency alarm, evacuation plan, or drills for plant and neighbouring churches, house, public road — if large flammable release occurs, no warning or evacuation, high community fatalities.
hazards.reason: Package: 'Emergency action plan does not cover plant evacuation; no drills; no emergency alarm.' Two church buildings and a house near plant; public road passes site; flammable solvents (aliphatic BP 81°C, aromatic BP 111°C); large inventory in reactor

hazards.hazard: Initiator feed pump continues during temperature excursion because no automatic initiator-feed shut-off — accelerates runaway polymerisation, shortens time to overpressure.
hazards.reason: Package: 'Not installed on R-1: ... automatic initiator-feed shut-off'. Stage 1 initiator pumped in after steam shutoff; Stage 2 co-feeds monomer and initiator over extended period; if temperature rises, continued initiator feed increases reaction rate; operator must manually stop pump
